newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada's Husky Oil in China oil recovery deal.
newsitem.headline: Canada's Husky Oil in China oil recovery deal.

text.p: Canada's Husky Oil Ltd said on Friday it signed an oil recovery contract with China National Petroleum Corp that will include spending US$100 million over five years on schemes to increase production at the Pucheng field in Henan Province, China.
Privately held Husky said it would provide staff, technology and development funds to the project in exchange for a share of the incremental oil production.
"The signing of this agreement expands Husky's international presence," Jamie Blair, president of Husky unit Husky Oil International Co Ltd, said in a statement.
Blair said he expected Husky to expand its presence in China's oil sector beyond the Pucheng project to other fields in China.

Calgary-based Husky, an integrated energy company controlled by Hong Kong-based tycoon Li Ka-Shing, also said it planned to work with CNPC on new exploration programs. ((Jeffrey Jones, Reuters Calgary Bureau (403) 531-1624))
